title: ad.metrics.snapshot
description: PAYLOAD of the `ad.metrics.snapshot` envelope. Topic: metrics.ad.snapshot. Emitted every 4h (§6.2, §12.2 evaluate every 4h) by connector-meta/google after an async insights report job (§5.3 insights via async reports, not polling). Carries platform-reported delivery + spend for one entity at one grain. Feeds the warehouse (ClickHouse ad_metrics_4h §8.5), the optimizer (§12), and the Budget Governor reconcile (§13.2 sum platform budgets <= cap). Stores both as_reported_at and is later finalized (§8.5 as_reported AND final). Platform numbers are labelled source=platform — NEVER presented as truth (§8.6).

platform_ref.description: The entity this snapshot is for, form platform:entity:id (e.g. meta:ad:123).

campaign_ref.description: Owning campaign ref (for rollups in the metrics layer).

window.description: The 4h reporting window this snapshot covers.

as_reported_at.description: When the platform reported these numbers (§8.5).

is_final.description: false = subject to platform restatement; true = finalized in the daily pass (§8.5).

metrics.description: Platform-reported metrics (source=platform). Money is INR paise. The SEMANTIC METRICS LAYER (§8.5) derives CPL/CPqL/ROAS from these + journey truth — never ad hoc.

frequency.description: Avg impressions per person (fatigue input §12.3 G5).

results.description: Platform-attributed results for the optimization event (e.g. leads).

emq.description: Event Match Quality on the optimization event (§11.3 target >=8); alert <6.

source.description: Always platform here — labels the number's origin so the product never presents platform ROAS as truth (§8.6).
